scope: Bounded read-only source/derivative/filter audit; no new pixelmeasure, UE, browser, source or asset changes
actualCrossIssueRegression: Existing livingdayrugY before0.821398 after0.718148 under2424shadertrial; productioncandidate not accepted

webSource.samplerBinding: WebGLTextures binds chosen min/mag, anisotropy capped by device; generateMipmap delegates GL
webSource.exactGPUFilterLimit: Full derivative matrix and driver mip/anisotropy behavior are not an application GLSL kernel; requested anisotropy is not an observed effective-cap query in this audit.

newTentMathematics.candidateResolved: Tent fullsupport sqrt(P²+B²), equivalent convolution of2halfwidth boxes; variance=(P²+B²)/24
newTentMathematics.nearPmuchLessThanB: CandidateRMS→oldRMS/sqrt(2), sharper resolved near edges. This is a real change from published2393near branch, not a source-equivalent proof.
newTentMathematics.equalPAndB: CandidateRMS=oldRMS although total support is sqrt(2)wider; oldsupport-only warning is incomplete.
newTentMathematics.unresolved: Wholebox with newquadrature footprint broadens oldmax by up tosqrt(2); periodicmean preserved, localCDF shape changed.
newTentMathematics.colourAndPhase: Normalizedmean does not prove canvas-raster/phase equivalence or CIEOtsu share equivalence.

derivativeLimit.fwidth: Per-component abs(ddx)+abs(ddy) axisaligned bounding span, not full 2x2anisotropic footprint.
derivativeLimit.RMSAlternative: sqrt(ddx²+ddy²) matches only the secondmoment of a uniform projected pixel box; this is not a proven replacement for the web anisotropic sampler. Can shrink up to1/sqrt(2)relativefwidth and thus risks the known0.7moire failure; not proposed blindly.

canvasRasterLimit: AHus source draws fractionalrects before texture upload; head gap2px, bed1.5px with source top inset1/bottom inset0.5 (not centered0.75/0.75). Analytic centered continuous rectangles do not reproduce source texel raster/phase. UVflip/sign must be established before any phase correction; no phasepatch proposed.

Canvas colours/edge texels then sRGB texture sampling/mips are an actual raster path; procedural linear face/mortar coverage plus independent jitter seed/fade is an approximation. Do not assert residual brightness is caused only by reconstruction width or2424.

boundedNextStep.lowestRiskFilterCorrection: Preserve EXACT oldmax/box coverage in sourceblur-dominated near magnification and in unresolved wholepixelbox regime; restrict any newtent reconstruction to genuine minification. This removes an unnecessary near change and keeps oldmoiré path, but any activation/blend rule remains a documented reconstruction assumption unless actual textureLOD is modeled. No numericthreshold search or implementation performed.
boundedNextStep.sourceFaithfulRoute: Sample the exact source canvas through texture mip/aniso pipeline rather than inventing another analytic kernel. Requires validating actual exported/imported texture/UV/material bindings; not a ready one-line patch or authorized Native change.
